methodologyNotes: Specs sourced primarily from ev-database.org (European-focused detail pages with usable kWh, peak kW, 0-100 km/h) and greencarscompare.com (US MSRP, US real-world range estimates, cargo cu ft). Manufacturer pages (Tesla, Kia, Rivian, Lucid, BMW, Hyundai, Ford, Chevrolet, VW) returned 403/404 for direct scraping; ev-database.org and greencarscompare.com serve as primary and corroborating sources respectively. priceUsd = US MSRP for the base/reference trim as listed on greencarscompare.com (cross-referenced with electrek.co article data where available). Range figures are real-world estimates (greencarscompare.com or ev-database.org methodology), NOT official EPA figures — EPA source pages were inaccessible. 0-60 mph converted from 0-100 km/h where needed (÷1.094 or as stated). Battery kWh = usable capacity. Cargo in cu ft (trunk only, seats-up). A null beats any guess. All sources accessed 2026-06-15.
